# DEV Artifact Crosswalk

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

DEV artifacts are workspace-defined development artifacts. They are not sourced from PMBOK or the PMI Guide to Business Analysis.

## Purpose

Map DEV artifacts to PM, BA, and DOC catalog entries. Define tailoring logic and dependency relationships.

## Overlap with PM, BA, and DOC Artifacts

| DEV Artifact | Related Catalog Entries | Relationship |
|-------------|------------------------|-------------|
| DEV-01 Prototype Build Brief | BA-01 (Situation statement), BA-05 (Required capabilities), BA-18 (User stories), BA-19 (Acceptance criteria), BA-20 (Models), BA-35 (Solution design) | Combines BA inputs at minimum viable level for prototype. When BA artifacts exist, reference rather than duplicate. |
| DEV-02 UX and Interface Design | BA-20 (Models) | BA models may include interface sketches and process flows. DEV-02 is the detailed design artifact. |
| DEV-03 Software Architecture Description | DEV-09 (ADR), DOC-07 (Dependencies register) | Architecture decisions feed DOC-07. ADRs document individual decisions underlying the architecture. |
| DEV-04 API and Integration Specification | DOC-07 (Dependencies register) | DOC-07 documents what integrations exist; DEV-04 specifies how they work. |
| DEV-05 Data Model and Database Design | DOC-06 (Data, Reports, Notifications Register) | DOC-06 documents business records and fields; DEV-05 adds technical schema, validation, and migration details. |
| DEV-06 Security and Privacy Design | DOC-09 (Risk and Controls Register), PM-44 (Risk register) | Security controls in DEV-06 may surface in DOC-09. Risks from security gaps go in PM-44. |
| DEV-07 Deployment and Runtime Operations Plan | DOC-08 (Support and Operations Guide) | DEV-07 covers technical deployment and runtime operations. DOC-08 covers business and user support. Reference DOC-08 for support procedures rather than duplicating. |
| DEV-08 Test Strategy and Plan | PM-55 (Quality test and evaluation documents), PM-52 (Quality control measurements) | PM-55 includes test plans. DEV-08 is the structured test strategy when formal testing is needed. |
| DEV-09 Architecture Decision Records | No direct overlap | Standalone artifact for recording technical decisions over time. |
| DEV-10 Repository and Development Guide | DOC-10 (User and Admin Guide) | DEV-10 is for developers; DOC-10 is for end users and admins. Separate audiences, share applicable content. |

## DEV Tailoring Logic

| Delivery Target | Rule |
|----------------|------|
| Prototype | DEV-01 (Prototype Build Brief) is the primary artifact. Other DEV artifacts may be combined into the build brief or created as lightweight notes. DEV-09 (ADR) recommended for recording key decisions. |
| Pilot | Create DEV-02 through DEV-08 when applicable. Minimum viable content  -  enough to validate the approach and plan for production. |
| Production | All 10 DEV artifacts current. DEV-07 (Deployment and Runtime Operations Plan) and DEV-06 (Security and Privacy Design) required before production release. |
| Non-software project | All DEV artifacts marked Not needed with evidence that the project does not deliver or modify software. |

## Dependency and Minimum Contents

| DEV Artifact | Common Predecessors | Notes |
|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| DEV-01 Prototype Build Brief | BA-01 (Situation statement), BA-05 (Required capabilities and features), BA-18 (User stories), BA-19 (Acceptance criteria), BA-33 (Product scope) | Combine BA inputs at minimum viable level |
| DEV-02 User Experience and Interface Design | BA-20 (Models), DEV-01 Prototype Build Brief | Interface design follows from workflow definition |
| DEV-03 Software Architecture Description | DEV-01 Prototype Build Brief, BA-33 (Product scope), DOC-07 (Application Dependencies Register) | Architecture follows from scope and dependencies |
| DEV-04 API and Integration Specification | DEV-03 Software Architecture Description, DOC-07 (Application Dependencies Register) | API design follows from architecture and dependency register |
| DEV-05 Data Model and Database Design | DEV-03 Software Architecture Description, DOC-06 (Data, Reports, and Notifications Register) | Data model follows from architecture and data register |
| DEV-06 Security and Privacy Design | DEV-03 Software Architecture Description, DOC-09 (Risk and Controls Register), PM-44 (Risk register) | Security design follows from architecture, risk, and controls |
| DEV-07 Deployment and Runtime Operations Plan | DEV-03 Software Architecture Description, DOC-08 (Support and Operations Guide) | Deployment plan follows from architecture and support guide |
| DEV-08 Test Strategy and Plan | DEV-01 Prototype Build Brief, BA-19 (Acceptance criteria) | Test plan follows from prototype brief and acceptance criteria |
| DEV-09 Architecture Decision Records | DEV-03 Software Architecture Description | ADRs are created throughout development, not sequentially |
| DEV-10 Repository and Development Guide | PM-37 (Resource management plan) | Development guide follows from team setup decisions |
